# TrustHub Wisdom Conversation Library

**Status:** Complete source-derived corpus. Every entry below is transcribed from the accessible PDF and marked **PDF-SOURCED**. Interpretive engine metadata is separately marked **NEW DESIGN** or **UNKNOWN**.

## Source and processing audit

- **PDF-SOURCED:** `TrustHub_Wisdom_Conversation_Library_1000_Starter.pdf`, 278 pages.
- **PDF accessibility:** YES. Text was extracted locally from the actual PDF; no external AI or service was used.
- **Actual conversations processed:** 1,000 (`TH-WIS-0001` through `TH-WIS-1000`), 1,000 unique IDs, no gaps or duplicates.
- **Categories:** 68. Source index counts reconcile exactly to the 1,000 body entries.
- **Completeness:** each entry has exactly one source `USER`, `WISDOM`, `NEXT MOVE`, and `DESIGN NOTE`; category counts match the source index.
- **Source owner labels (preserved verbatim):** `AGENT` 30, `AI` 479, `AUTHORED` 401, `COMMUNITY` 75, `NO_AI` 15.
- PDF line wraps were joined into normal prose spacing; wording, punctuation, speaker labels, and source design notes were otherwise retained. Original PDF page locators are recorded per entry.
- The PDF says its entries are original TrustHub-oriented patterns generated from product architecture and research inputs, not copied from external websites (PDF page 278).

## Source owner labels

| PDF label | PDF-described meaning |
|---|---|
| `AUTHORED` | TrustHub-controlled messages whose wording is controlled exactly. |
| `AI` | Natural-language understanding and contextual phrasing. |
| `COMMUNITY` | Local opted-in participant response/source. |
| `AGENT` | Human intervention, including local guidance, complex cases, follow-up, and escalation. |
| `NO_AI` | Deterministic copy that does not need a model call; retained as its own source label. |

These definitions are **PDF-SOURCED** from the source architecture section; they do not establish that capabilities are implemented.

## Record fields and interpretation

- **PDF-SOURCED:** ID, category, owner/source label, exact user message, exact Wisdom response, source `NEXT MOVE`, source `DESIGN NOTE`, and page locator.
- **TRIGGER:** the exact user message is the trigger; its PDF category names the pattern.
- **TONE (NEW DESIGN):** a concise tone tag inferred from category and wording; original wording and design note remain authoritative.
- **VARIABLES (NEW DESIGN audit):** only explicit `{...}`, `[...]`, or `<...>` placeholder tokens are listed. Proper names are not reinterpreted as template variables.
- **NEXT STATE (NEW DESIGN):** proposed category-level mapping to the blueprint state model, not a PDF field or implemented transition.
- **FOLLOW-UP (PDF-SOURCED):** the source field is `NEXT MOVE`; reproduced verbatim, not assumed to be scheduled follow-up.
- **ESCALATION and MEMORY IMPLICATION:** proposed category-level reading only; no unsupported behavior is inserted.
- The PDF supplies an owner label per entry, not a separate owner for each sentence.
